ad_intro:
Slurrp Farm (slurrpfarm.com) is a Kids Food brand running ~35 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.40-70L/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Millet-based kids-food brand (Wholsum Foods).

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: mom-testimonial gap, demo reels missing - The gap: mom-testimonial / demo Reels. (2) Landing page: a product grid with no mom-proof or demo. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Mid-market/SMB lead - high closability with a fast test budget.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Mom-testimonial gap, demo Reels missing. The gap: mom-testimonial / demo Reels.
Copy leak: Current angle is product-led. Missing angle: mom-trust + nutrition story over flavor lists.
Landing page leak: A product grid with no mom-proof or demo.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy mom-testimonial / demo Reels
Shoot 15 fifteen-second mom-testimonial / demo Reels and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add mom-testimonials + demo UGC on PDPs. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
